page.overview:
Who is Cam Attaway?

Cam Attaway, often simply called Cam, is an Alpha Team minifigure introduced in 2000 before making her physical debut in 2001.

In 5714 LEGO Alpha Team, Cam wears a black Alpha Team uniform with red as her secondary color on her right side. She wears a sleeveless shirt, exposing her bright yellow arms. Her torso is decorated with a chain necklace, the Alpha Team emblem, and a dark grey work vest equipped with an oil can and three wrenches. Her legs have pouches and kneepads. She has short bright red hair with black tips. Her face has red lipstick, blue sunglasses, feminine eyelashes, angled eyebrows, and a microphone headset.

Cam's first physical minifigure recreates her design from the video game, but greatly simplifies the details on her work vest and changes the shape of the oil canister. Her hair is a bright red Mini Wig, Girl and loses the black tips. Her blue sunglasses are clear with purple tints, and she has purple eyeshadow.

In Mission Deep Sea, Cam has wears an earth blue wetsuit without any of the mechanic gear from her previous iterations. Her torso has a zipper that is partially unzipped, barely revealing a white undershirt. The Alpha Team logo has been moved to her left breast, and a pair of zipper pockets have been added directly beneath. She has a utility belt and leg printing similar to other Alpha Team agents. Her hair color has been changed to dark red, her sunglasses have been removed, and she now has green eyes with red eyeshadow. Her hair can alternatively be replaced with a dark grey scuba airtank and helmet with a transparent blue visor.
